caribbean.headline: Showery Weather and Moderate Seas in Turks and Caicos
caribbean.paragraph: Turks and Caicos are seeing easterly winds near 20 kt, seas to 4.5 ft with an E swell period around 5 s, and 62% rain probability. I recommend mariners secure small craft, expect brief heavy showers with locally reduced visibility, and note Roatan will have stronger winds up to 23 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Light Southerly Winds, Small Seas in Mediterranean
mediterranean.paragraph: Marseille is experiencing southerly winds near 15 kt with 3.5 ft seas and an SSW swell of 5 s, and I am tracking a 38% rain probability for the port today. I also note Mykonos reporting higher winds up to 20 kt while seas remain modest across the eastern basin.
